payload.contentHtml:
Bo Wang
Great interview of @StefanoErmon
by @ziv_ravid
in the latest episode of Information Bottleneck — worth a watch: https://x.com/ziv_ravid/status/2034692961359876550?s=20…

Really resonate with Stefano’s framing: autoregressive models are like typewriters, diffusion models are editors.

When we built scGPT three years ago, we went with autoregressive training—it was the natural choice at the time.

But three years later, I think we got the architecture wrong. Diffusion LMs feel much better aligned with what biological omics actually needs.

There’s also an underappreciated advantage on the reasoning side for diffusion models in biology. More on that soon—stay tuned 👀
对 @StefanoErmon 的精彩采访 @StefanoErmon
由 @ziv_ravid
在《Information Bottleneck》最新一期中——值得一看： https://x.com/ziv_ravid/status/2034692961359876550?s=20…

非常共鸣于 Stefano 的表述：自回归模型就像打字机，扩散模型是编辑。

三年前我们开发 scGPT 时，选择了自回归训练——这在当时是很自然的选择。

但三年后，我认为我们的架构搞错了。扩散语言模型感觉更契合生物组学实际所需。

在生物学中，扩散模型还有一个被忽视的推理优势。更多相关内容即将揭晓——敬请关注 👀
@BoWang87

The most interesting thing about the diffusion LM debate isn't what it means for languages. It's what it means for biological foundation models. The blog arguing diffusion LMs will outscale autoregressive models is making the rounds. The argument is interesting — but it's
关于扩散语言模型（LM）辩论最有趣的一点，并不是它对语言意味着什么，而是它对生物基础模型意味着什么。 这篇声称扩散语言模型将超越自回归模型的博客正在广泛传播。这个观点很有意思——但它...

热门回复

@Bo Wang ♥ 33 · 💬 4

Had a fun + packed panel this morning at
@NVIDIAGTC
with
@Prof_Lundberg
,
@Ronalfa
, and Phil Lorenz.

Hot takes flying on scaling laws in biology — but the love for seems universal

Huge shoutout to
@DBBurkhardt
for the fantastic moderation

Hopefully the recording will
今天上午在
@NVIDIAGTC
参加了一场有趣且内容充实的座谈会，与
@Prof_Lundberg
、
@Ronalfa
以及 Phil Lorenz。

生物学中的标度律相关的热门观点层出不穷——但对 的喜爱似乎是普遍的

特别鸣谢
@DBBurkhardt
对出色的管理工作

希望这个录音会
